    // How it works

    From curious to capable, in four moves

    No subscriptions to nothing. Each step ends with something you can show.

    01

    Pick a track

    Six tracks, each a sequence of courses rather than a list.

    02

    Learn in short blocks

    Twenty-minute lessons with a project you finish the same week.

    03

    Meet a mentor live

    Weekly office hours and critique nights in the live room.

    04

    Ship something real

    Finish with a project and a certificate you can show.

    // Questions

    Before you start

    Yes. Every course includes an illustrated sample classroom with a practical exercise, a short knowledge check and progress saved only on your browser. No account is required.

    You can explore the agenda, preview room controls, try a local registration form and download a real calendar file. There is no connected meeting, live video, payment or email service.

    The artwork includes a sample completion certificate. Finishing the sample classroom records local progress only; it is not accreditation or a verifiable professional qualification.

    The same themes support academy and independent-educator presets. Courses, instructor profiles, cohort applications and resources can be adapted to a real organisation. Connect your own enrolment and payment services before publishing.

    Start with a short sample lesson and a ten-minute exercise. Full course pages show the exact number of lessons and learning-material minutes; programme pages separately explain their weekly commitment.

    Start with one course. Keep the loop going.

    Free courses need no card. Paid courses come with 30 days to change your mind.
